content: Socket.IO regenerates the socket id on every reconnect, including after a page reload/lock, so the socket id must never be used as player identity. Recommended: generate an app-level session/player token client-side, persist it in localStorage, and send it in the connection auth payload (socket.auth = {token}) on every connect and reconnect attempt; server maps token -> player record independent of the underlying transport connection to re-associate a returning socket with the same player and room seat.
